fdedc78b.value: The way the content script was checking for the availability of Nano was incorrect. It's working now, but gets stuck during the "available === 'downloading'" method. Fix the script to check for when the model is downloaded and resume the function.

eecf9f9c.value: When the popover/dialog is open, it should be placed on top of the button that opened it. Update the CSS to position it on top of the button.

fd1f98d7.value: Update the image check functionality to check for both the natural width and the rendered width.

0b9c2e39.value: The script needs to be updated for a use case where the image may be a child (or sub-child) of an anchor element or button element. Interactive elements can't be nested. The icon needs to be placed outside of an anchor or button (but still on top of the image) to prevent the interatcive element from activating the anchor or button for the image.

9d9832b2.value: If an icon is clicked, and the alt text is generated, then the dialog is closed, the response from the AI should be cached. This allows the user to re-open the same icon and not have to call the AI to generate the alt text again.
